name: Cavitation / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A short suction gulp, then a dense wet tissue pop as fluid pressure tears the limb off, followed by a brief acidic spray. Hollow implosion rather than a dry impact.
